name: OperationsDrawer
intent: A drawer for reviewing and editing the operations under a single object: a header with the object identifier, its WBS path, an overall progress bar and a walkthrough link; a compact table listing each operation with its WT / PREV / BAC / EV metrics and an editable progress field; a discard / save footer.
when: Editing an object's operations' progress in a side drawer
Reviewing WT / PREV / BAC / EV per operation with inline edits

chooseOver.because: OperationsDrawer is the composed operations-editing surface; Drawer is the generic sliding container

notes: authored during the develop merge reconciliation

props.name: wbs
props.description: Full WBS path, shown muted under the title.

props.name: progress
props.description: Overall completion percentage (0–100) for the header bar.

props.name: page
props.description: Optional pager shown beside the title (e.g. 1 of 4).

usage: Use OperationsDrawer to help users navigate through your application or content hierarchy. This component provides clear wayfinding and helps users understand their current location within the interface.

OperationsDrawer is ideal for multi-page applications, content-heavy interfaces, or any situation where users need to move between different sections. Keep navigation patterns consistent across your application for better user experience.
